urls.title: Property URLs
urls.description: List of property URLs from VRBO, Expedia, or Hotels.com. Platform is auto-detected from URL.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of property URLs scraped in parallel. Higher finishes large lists faster but increases block risk.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Residential proxies are used by default and strongly recommended — the Mobile GraphQL API blocks datacenter IPs.
